basic_info.description: Brilliantly renovated Mediterranean Revival perched at the height of the Outer Richmond featuring an open concept living room, dining room, and kitchen, plus a separate family room, 4BR and 4.5BA with a luxurious primary suite, ample storage, garage, and pristine backyard. Freshly remodeled throughout with recessed lighting and skylights, complimented by sparkling bathrooms with exquisite porcelain tile. Expertly designed kitchen graced with a sleek island with second sink, counter height oven and microwave, dishwasher, and quartz countertops. Spectacular primary suite includes multi-head shower, separate tub, and dual sinks, the adjoining sitting room opens to an elevated deck leading to the spacious backyard. The ground level holds the garage, washer and dryer, two full BA, and two BR, a family room with wet bar, plus access to the backyard with fresh landscaping and sophisticated fencing. Nestled in a quaint neighborhood, blocks away from natural gems and vibrant shopping and dinning.
